Detailed Description

Broker client factory interface.

Classes that need to dynamically create broker client objects must use a factory to do so, instead of creating the clients directly (to avoid dependencies with real implementations). Such factory will be provided as a dependency so it can be mocked while unit testing. A broker client factory mock will return broker client mocks whenever an expectation of a call to create_instance() is satisfied.
